question: What is the value of sin 28° sin 35° sin 45° sec 62° sec 55°?
solution:
**Given:**

sin 28° sin 35° sin 45° sec 62° sec 55°

**Concept used:**

sec A° = cosec(90° - A°)

cosec\:theta={1over sin\:theta}

sin 45° = {1over sqrt 2}

**Calculation:**

sin 28° sin 35° sin 45° sec 62° sec 55°

=> sin 28° sin 35° sin 45° cosec (90o - 62°) cosec (90o - 55°)

=> sin 28° sin 35° sin 45° cosec 28o cosec 35°

=> large sin 28° sin 35° sin 45° over sin 28° sin 35°

=> sin 45° = {1over sqrt 2} 

**∴ The value of sin 28° sin 35° sin 45° sec 62° sec 55° is bf (1)/({sqrt 2 )}.**
175
